`encrypted.der` was produced by `github.com/krotos139/go-gostcrypto` at commit
`409be1d9982195558ce16fabd5d0ad20454bee3c` using
`pkcs8.MarshalEncryptedPrivateKey`. It uses the public R 1323565.1.041-2022
Appendix A.4 test key, PBES2/GOST 28147-89 with the TC26 Z parameter set,
and password `interop-password`. The key is public test material and must not
be used for real credentials.
